bundle.shortDescription: A local-first knowledge platform built on plain Markdown files
bundle.longDescription: Inner Empire turns an ordinary folder of Markdown files into a linked knowledge base: wiki links, backlinks, tags, typed properties, full-text search, a graph view and a canvas. Everything stays on your machine, in files any editor can open.
